basic_info.description: 558 Athens Street is a timeless 1920s home in San Francisco's Excelsior neighborhood, thoughtfully expanded and newly updated for today's lifestyle. This 3-bed, 2-bath residence offers a flexible layout across two levels, with west-facing views that bring in natural light and sunset charm. The main level features a spacious living room with a fireplace, an open dining area, and a newly remodeled kitchen with skylight and full appliance package - perfect for everyday living and entertaining. Two well-sized bedrooms, including one with a private view deck, offer peaceful off-street retreats, with a full bath nearby. Downstairs, the remodeled primary en suite doubles as a family room or guest space, with sliding door access to a terraced patio and yard. A dedicated laundry room, attached garage with EV charging and interior access, and welcoming foyer add convenience. Located near McLaren Park and Excelsior's local shops and transit, this home blends classic San Francisco architecture with modern updates and neighborhood energy.
